target_customer: Public school systems and ministries in low and middle income countries, paid by donors since Darsel is a nonprofit
problem: Students in low bandwidth settings lack personalized math help; Darsel tutors K12 math over SMS, WhatsApp and Facebook Messenger on basic phones.
business_model: Donor and grant funded nonprofit, free to students and teachers

founders.name: Abdulhamid Haidar
education: MIT, math, computer science and economics
founders.background_notes: YC page and Stanford GSB article.

competitors.name: Rori (Rising Academies)
competitors.what: WhatsApp math tutor for students in low income countries

technical_complexity.rationale: A curriculum aligned adaptive tutor over text channels with low data needs was feasible with chatbot tooling but required localized content and a human support team.

defensibility.rationale: Question and student skill data and government relationships help, but a similar WhatsApp tutor (Rori) existed and chatbot tech was available to others.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent moved on it; as a nonprofit it is not an acquisition target.

market_need_then: COVID learning loss and poor connectivity made text based tutoring attractive; the Stanford GSB article describes testing with students in Nigeria in fall 2020 and early evidence of improved test scores.

brand_strength.rationale: Strong institutional credibility from Stanford and MIT Solve coverage, but no sourced evidence about the name or brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Darsel is a nonprofit math chatbot that reports 264,000 students across Jordan, India and Nigeria by July 2025. It joined the Google.org Accelerator in June 2025 and won a WISE Prize award per the prize site. Growth comes from donor and government partnerships rather than venture rounds, so success is measured in reach and an RCT registered in 2026.
notes: Google.org amount conflicts (1 million in the DRK Foundation page versus at least 500K elsewhere), so amount is null. A WISE Prize third place of 200,000 dollars appears on wise-qatar.org but the date was not seen, so it is not recorded as a round. CB Insights total of 500K is stale and unverified. Reach figures conflict (50,000 in 2023 per the Jordan Times, 264,000 in 2025). Darsel is a nonprofit so VC style outcomes do not apply. Name origin not found.
